title: One Of 2025's Best Roguelikes Will Soon Be Free For Switch Online Members
summary:
Rogue 'em up until 3rd December.

Nintendo is back with another Free Game Trial for all of its NSO members in Europe, and it's a real good'un this time.

Last year's wonderful roguelike, Absolum, is the next game in the spotlight, available for free to all those with a Nintendo Switch Online subscription in Europe from tomorrow (27th November) until 3rd December.

title: Nintendo Restocks Metroid Dread Physical Copies Ahead Of Metroid Ravenous Launch
summary:
Demand for Dread.

When Nintendo announced Metroid Ravenous for the Switch 2, there was a reported increase in Metroid Dread sales. This also led to a supposed boost in physical sales of the "out-of-print" Switch title, with some online listings asking "well above" the retail price.
